notes.title: various updates to game
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Ykj1ZDg.gif[/img]

sorry for delay guys! have been doing some important networking events, and also working on the game as time permitted.

added a few new weapons to the game - also busy at work adding levels to the game to add some content so people can enjoy more hours of content when they get the game!

some youtube videos showing new features:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OK_PIS3d9ik

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0YyDtUxIbxk

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CHrdBEQ2P5c


list of changes

- added pulse gun
- added charge gun 
- added many missiles including cruise / heavy / cluster missile
- added mines
- added 3 new levels!

notes.title: aesthetic update
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/UHpL28Z.gif[/img]

Working on the look and feel of the space battles in game. Looking forward to getting the weapons added later. Have some different ideas for weapon additions - not sure which one to choose.

Thinking of doing sprites for a green bolt type cannon, that or 3d glowing orbs. I wonder if sprites look too retro for this style of game?
